```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(palmerpenguins))
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

# Filter out rows with missing or non-finite values
penguins_clean <- penguins %>%
  filter(!is.na(flipper_length_mm), !is.na(body_mass_g))

# Create a scatter plot with cleaned data
penguins_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "#1b9e77", "Chinstrap" = "#d95f02", "Gentoo" = "#7570b3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Flipper Length vs Body Mass",
    subtitle = "Grouped by Species",
    x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    y = "Body Mass (g)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
